releaseNotesMarkdown:
### cert-manager/trust-manager (trust-manager)

### [`v0.26.0`](https://redirect.github.com/cert-manager/trust-manager/releases/tag/v0.26.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/cert-manager/trust-manager/compare/v0.25.0...v0.26.0)

trust-manager is the easiest way to manage security-critical TLS trust bundles in Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters.

##### What's Changed

This release removes the compromised eMudhra roots from the default CA bundle. It also contains a chart fix and dependency bumps.

⚠️ **The default CA bundle installed by the v0.25.0 chart trusts the compromised eMudhra CAs.** If you use `useDefaultCAs: true`, upgrade to v0.26.0. See [eMudhra compromise](https://cert-manager.io/docs/trust/trust-manager/#emudhra-compromise).

Thanks to all contributors! ❤️ 🚀

##### eMudhra CA compromise

- **The default CA bundle no longer includes the compromised roots**, emSign ECC Root CA - G3 and AAA Certificate Services. The v0.25.0 chart installs `trust-pkg-debian-trixie:20250419.2`, which still contains both roots. If you cannot upgrade yet, set `defaultPackageImage.tag` to `20250419-deb13u1.0` or later.
- **The trust package images are rebuilt**, as `trust-pkg-debian-trixie:20250419-deb13u1.1` and `trust-pkg-debian-bookworm:20250419-deb12u2.1`, on the latest base image and Go 1.27.3. The older images were never exposed through their own trust store: they only copy the bundle to trust-manager and never make TLS connections. We rebuilt them so that vulnerability scanners report them clean.
- **trust-manager is built with Go 1.27.3**, which distrusts the compromised intermediates (CVE-2026-111943). It also fixes the other Go standard library vulnerabilities that scanners report against v0.25.0.

* \[CI] Merge trust-package-upgrade-debian-bookworm-main into main by [@​github-actions](https://redirect.github.com/github-actions)\[bot] in [#​1134](https://redirect.github.com/cert-manager/trust-manager/pull/1134)
* \[CI] Merge trust-package-upgrade-debian-trixie-main into main by [@​github-actions](https://redirect.github.com/github-actions)\[bot] in [#​1135](https://redirect.github.com/cert-manager/trust-manager/pull/1135)
* Rebuild trust package images without the compromised eMudhra roots by [@​wallrj-cyberark](https://redirect.github.com/wallrj-cyberark) in [#​1144](https://redirect.github.com/cert-manager/trust-manager/pull/1144)

- fix: merge commonLabels as a map to avoid duplicate label keys by [@​pgmpofu](https://redirect.github.com/pgmpofu) in [#​1111](https://redirect.github.com/cert-manager/trust-manager/pull/1111)
- chart: document that authorizedSecrets cannot grant Secret creation by [@​kta1kri](https://redirect.github.com/kta1kri) in [#​1110](https://redirect.github.com/cert-manager/trust-manager/pull/1110)
